question: A proton bonds to the oxygen atom of a solvent water to give a ______________ hydronium ion.
solution:
The correct answer is __**trigonal pyramidal**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• A proton bonds to the oxygen atom of a solvent water to give a **trigonal pyramidal** hydronium ion.
 
• The hydronium ion (H₃O⁺) has a central oxygen atom bonded to three hydrogen atoms and one lone pair of electrons, resulting in a **trigonal pyramidal** geometry.<
